claims.statement: For every m>=100 ordinary path-star with r_i in {2,3,4}, every represented tip branch i and every integer 1<=k with 2k<=N+2, the registered exact-ratio tip-surplus expression is strictly positive, with N=sum_i r_i, h=1+2a_2+4a_3+7a_4, C=(1+2z)product_i B_(r_i), E=z(1+z)^N, U_i=(1+2z)B_(r_i-1)product_(ell!=i)B_(r_ell), and integer zero-extended coefficients.
claims.scope: Proposed m>=100 subcase only of the registered all-m exact-ratio tip-surplus claim; the surplus statement itself has no first-descent or selector premise. If applied to the primary route, preserve x as the least natural k with Delta_k P<0 under zero extension (including terminal rank), p with x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, 2p<=alpha, and strict current-p flags Delta_p A0<0 and Delta_p Ai<0; retain one original endpoint tag and all r_i original tips. This review does not cover m<100, endpoint surplus, or an all-original-leaf, payment, MASS, arbitrary-tree, or Erdős993 conclusion.
claims.reason: Independent algebraic audit validates the m>=100 proof after explicitly supplying binomial log-concavity in the second low-rank curvature bracket. The exact finite checks corroborate constants and boundaries only. The registered m<100 base remains unproved, so the all-m predicate stays open; no formal award is proposed for this composition.
